text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her primary goal, the Tokyo 
Daishoten, drawing near, we decided to 
enter the Tenno Sho (Autumn) so Inari One 
could gain experience on a grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Running in this Tenno Sho (Autumn) are 
the two Umamusume who stand at the center 
of this era...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Battling against them is sure to become 
immense fuel for Inari One's growth...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The "White Lightning", Tamamo Cross, and 
the "Monster", Oguri Cap...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, lined up together, it's quite a 
sight, ain't it. I sure would've loved to 
stand here with a title of my own on my 
back!
choice_data_list: This is going to be a tough battle.

This is going to be a tough battle, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya! After all, they're calling this 
the clash of the titans!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna savor every bit of it... The 
heat of this top-tier festival!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—We finally get to race together, Oguri. 
I've been lookin' forward to this day for 
the longest time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you all right? Did you sleep well 
last night? Were you able to eat?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"What's with all that worrying?! Are you 
my mom on the morning of a field trip or 
what?!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I slept soundly. And I ate well, too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Because... I was looking forward to 
today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Oguri. Today, I'm gonna take 
you down fair and square. And I'll prove 
that I'm the best in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Brace yourself now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I've already steeled my resolve 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well look at that, you can dish out 
a witty comeback too, eh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well then... shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tama and Oguri really are something 
else...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Tamamo Cross... a runt with insane 
competitive spirit and an unbelievable 
finishing burst... She looks like her 
usual self standing next to Oguri, but—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Sheesh, neither of them can hide that 
crazy intimidating aura of theirs. But 
that's what makes it so good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm throwing myself into your festival 
with everything I've got, too!!
